title: Migrate legacy validating state and close the write guard's fail-open tail
action: Per D13, two coupled changes. (1) Coerce a legacy phase 'validating' read from .bee/state.json OR .bee/lanes/*.json to 'planning', following the existing precedent at lib/state.mjs:3299 (isKnownPhase(phase) ? phase : ...). The lane path is not optional (advisor finding 3): the phase read at guards.mjs:1240 can arrive from a lane/workflow record via resolveWriteRecord -> resolvePipeline (guards.mjs:256-265, state.mjs:1813), so an uncoerced legacy lane would hit the new deny. Without the coercion a live repo cannot leave the phase at all: bee.mjs:2931-2934 refuses state set before any write when the PRE-mutation phase is unknown, and state set is the only verb that changes phase. (2) The write guard's true fall-through tail is lib/guards.mjs:1366 -- NOT :1318, which is the GATED_PHASES branch's own local return. Flip it from return { allow: true } to a deny, NARROWED to !isKnownPhase(phase) using the exported helper at lib/state.mjs:54-56. The narrowing is mandatory: 'reviewing', 'scribing', 'compounding' and 'grooming' are real PHASES members matched by no branch, they reach the tail today, and that path carries no underAllowedPrefix or idle_gate carve-out -- a blanket deny would hard-block every write during ordinary post-approval work. Fresh and corrupt repos are already safe upstream: guards.mjs:1240 collapses missing/empty phase to 'idle', handled by TERMINAL_PHASES at :1294. This cell also owns the fixtures its own verify trips on: test_guards.mjs:1036-1059 ('unknown phase falls through open', fixture phase 'executing') flips from asserting allow to asserting deny -- that flip is THIS cell's behavior change, not vd-4's. Twins move in the same commit.

truths: A state file holding phase 'validating' reads as 'planning' and state set succeeds from it
A LANE record (.bee/lanes/*.json) holding phase 'validating' coerces on the same read path, not just the default store
checkWrite denies a source write when phase is a non-empty string outside KNOWN_PHASES
checkWrite still allows writes when phase is reviewing, scribing, compounding or grooming
A repo with no .bee/state.json is unaffected

artifacts.substantive: tail returns a deny guarded by !isKnownPhase, no blanket deny
legacy phase coercion on the read path, covering the lane path

key_links: the deny reuses isKnownPhase exported from lib/state.mjs, never a second hardcoded phase list
the coercion sits where resolvePipeline (state.mjs:1813) and the default store both pass through, per guards.mjs:256-265
prohibitions: No blanket deny on the tail
No new hardcoded phase list -- derive from KNOWN_PHASES
No change to the TERMINAL_PHASES or GATED_PHASES branches

trace.outcome: D13: coerced legacy phase 'validating' -> 'planning' at every state/lane read (readState, readStateStrict, laneRecordFrom shared by readLane+readLaneStrict), and closed checkWrite's true fall-through tail (guards.mjs:1366) to a deny narrowed to !isKnownPhase(phase) — reviewing/scribing/compounding/grooming still allow, no blanket deny, TERMINAL_PHASES/GATED_PHASES untouched. Flipped the one fixture the tail-flip trips (test_guards.mjs unknown-phase test) and added 4 new D13 tests. Mirrored packages/bee/lib/{state,guards}.mjs into .bee/bin/lib/ last, in this same commit.
trace.verify_output: test_guards.mjs: 62 passed, 0 failed (includes flipped NET branch 7 unknown-phase-denies assertion and 4 new D13 tests: legacy state.json coercion+isKnownPhase, legacy lane coercion via readLane/readLaneStrict/checkWrite+session, four known-but-unhandled phases still allow, no-state.json repo unaffected). test_bee_write_guard_hook.mjs: 33 passed, 0 failed (end-to-end hook subprocess tests, vendoring packages/bee/lib source — unaffected by the guard change since none of its fixtures use an unknown phase). Both runs exit 0.
